workflow_metadata.description: Post-architecture service development workflow building from finalized specification artifacts (Steps 10+)
workflow_metadata.entry_condition: All architecture workflow steps 0-9 completed; build_ready_index.json and BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md exist for target system

environment: Secrets management strategy defined (no plaintext secrets in repo)
Container runtime available if infrastructure.json indicates container packaging
verification_commands: Verify each service listed has required artifacts (fail-fast if missing)
Report dependency groups and critical path from build_ready_index.json
baseline_policies: All new code must map to a declared interface or internal function in service_architecture.json
No endpoints added outside api_contracts.json without architecture change workflow
Data schema mutations require synchronized update to data_models.json and migration plan

degradation_signals: Implementing code for an undefined interface
Schema drift: code model diverges from data_models.json
before_every_operation: CHECK operations_since_refresh (in dev_working_memory.json if present; else treat as 0)
CONFIRM targeted service & stage have not advanced in another concurrent session
ASSERT no pending quality gate failures blocking this action

trigger_conditions: Token context saturation risk (model reports truncation or prior step details missing)
sequence: PAUSE all code edits / file writes
WRITE current action + rationale to dev_process_log.md
SNAPSHOT: regenerate dev_context_checkpoint.md summarizing current stage & open tasks
RELOAD authoritative artifacts: service_architecture.json, api_contracts.json, data_models.json for active service
RESTATE: system_name, active_service, stage, next_action, outstanding_quality_gates

snapshot_management.snapshot_frequency: Every 2 operations OR on stage exit (whichever first)
snapshot_management.risk_escalation_policy: If same blocking issue appears in 2 consecutive snapshots → flag as escalation_needed in dev_progress_tracker.json

micro_batching_rules: Split large implementation tasks (> ~150 lines planned) into sub-actions (definition scaffolds, then logic fill, then tests)
Never open more than 3 services concurrently; finish or snapshot before switching
Prefer referencing artifact paths rather than re-inlining large JSON spec bodies
compression_guidelines: Summarize unchanged sections with ellipses in dev_process_log.md
Store verbose test output under test_reports/ and reference path only
For repetitive endpoint patterns, document one exemplar then index of variations

working_memory_structure.update_rule: Increment operations_since_refresh after each discrete file change or test execution; reset on refresh

minimum_requirements.TEST_COVERAGE: >= primary path tests + contract tests for all external interfaces
minimum_requirements.SECURITY_BASELINE: All declared authN/authZ paths enforced, no critical static analysis issues
minimum_requirements.OBSERVABILITY_INSTRUMENTATION: Metrics/traces/log events for key operations enumerated in observability.json
minimum_requirements.PERFORMANCE_SMOKE: Baseline throughput & latency within preliminary targets from service_architecture.json
minimum_requirements.RUNBOOK_COMPLETENESS: Runbook sections: startup, shutdown, config change, dependency outage, scaling, incident triage
minimum_requirements.MISSION_VALIDATION: System demonstrates ability to achieve its stated mission with typical user flows
minimum_requirements.USER_ACCEPTANCE: Real users can accomplish intended tasks in realistic environments

development_stages.name: Initialization & Environment Bootstrap
development_stages.description: Establish reproducible development environment per service dependency groups and capture system mission

actions.description: Parse build_ready_index.json to enumerate dependency layers
Create dev_progress_tracker.json with all services initial status=not_started
Initialize per-service dev_current_focus.md with first implementation target
Validate required runtimes, toolchains, and lint/test frameworks
Record environment baseline hashes/versions to dev_process_log.md
Create SYSTEM_MISSION_STATEMENT.md capturing the fundamental 'why' of the system
Create USER_SCENARIOS.md with realistic user stories and expected outcomes
Create SUCCESS_CRITERIA.md defining measurable mission success indicators

development_stages.name: Code Scaffold & Domain Model Realization
development_stages.description: Transform architectural skeleton into concrete code foundations

actions.description: For each service (dependency order), generate directory skeleton if absent
Instantiate data models from data_models.json (entities, value objects, DTOs)
Create placeholder interface adapters aligning with api_contracts.json
Add configuration loader honoring infrastructure.json parameters
Register dependency injection graph (if applicable)
Initial lint & type pass to ensure structural integrity

development_stages.name: Core Use Case & Interface Implementation
development_stages.description: Implement primary functional flows declared in service_architecture.json

actions.description: Rank use cases by critical path & external dependency exposure
Implement highest priority domain services (pure logic first)
Wire API handlers to domain services per api_contracts.json
Enforce validation, authN/authZ rules per compliance.json
Add error taxonomy matching contract error schemas
Update dev_process_log.md with implemented endpoints and logic mapping

exit_criteria: All contract endpoints return non-stub responses

development_stages.name: Persistence Layer & Migration Enablement
development_stages.description: Align persistent storage implementation with data_models.json and define migration lifecycle

actions.description: Generate schema migrations from data_models.json structural definitions
Implement repository/data access adapters (no business logic)
Introduce caching/TTL layers per infrastructure.json
Add data validation & normalization pre-persistence
Write rollback plan for each migration (idempotency, ordering)

development_stages.name: Integration Surfaces & Cross-Service Contracts
development_stages.description: Implement outbound/inbound service integrations and messaging per interface contracts

actions.description: Enumerate all external dependencies from service_architecture.json
Implement client adapters or message producers per ICDs
Add retries/circuit breakers/timeouts consistent with resiliency policies
Create contract tests verifying shape & error conditions
Record dependency wiring in dev_process_log.md

development_stages.name: Security & Compliance Hardening
development_stages.description: Embed security controls and compliance checks defined in compliance.json & service specs

actions.description: Map each compliance requirement to concrete implementation artifact
Add input sanitization, request quotas, and permission scopes
Integrate audit/event logging for security-relevant actions
Run static analysis & dependency vulnerability scans
Document residual risk items in dev_process_log.md

development_stages.name: Observability & Operational Telemetry
development_stages.description: Implement metrics, logs, traces, health, and profiling instrumentation per observability.json

actions.description: Map required telemetry signals to code injection points
Add structured logging with correlation IDs
Emit performance & business metrics (counters, histograms, gauges)
Add distributed tracing spans for critical flows
Implement health/liveness/readiness endpoints/signals

development_stages.name: Testing Pyramid Realization
development_stages.description: Implement comprehensive testing layers aligning with testing_requirements.json & FUNCTIONAL_TEST_STRATEGY.md

actions.description: Unit tests for domain and helper logic
Contract tests for each external interface (provider & consumer)
Integration tests instantiating real service boundaries
End-to-end scenario tests across critical user/value flows
Performance smoke tests capturing baseline metrics
Coverage & quality report generation

development_stages.name: CI/CD Pipeline Implementation
development_stages.description: Translate cicd_pipeline.json into executable automation & policy gates

actions.description: Scaffold pipeline stages (build, test, scan, package, deploy) per plan
Integrate quality gates (coverage %, static analysis, security scan thresholds)
Add artifact versioning & provenance metadata
Implement deployment promotion logic (dev→staging→preprod)
Document pipeline triggers & rollback strategy

development_stages.name: Deployment & Runtime Validation (Dev/Staging)
development_stages.description: Deploy services into controlled environment and validate operational behavior

actions.description: Provision runtime environment from infrastructure.json
Deploy service set respecting dependency sequencing
Run smoke & contract tests against live endpoints
Validate telemetry ingestion & dashboards
Capture baseline performance & resource profile

development_stages.name: Operational Readiness & Runbook Verification
development_stages.description: Confirm operational preparedness and incident handling pathways

actions.description: Validate runbooks cover all critical operational scenarios
Conduct failure injection exercises (dependency outage, degraded latency)
Measure MTTR simulation vs target
Confirm alert thresholds & escalation paths

development_stages.name: Mission Validation & Operational Testing
development_stages.description: Validate system achieves its intended mission through operational testing with real user scenarios

actions.description: Create operational test environment simulating realistic conditions
Execute user scenarios from USER_SCENARIOS.md with typical users
Measure success criteria from SUCCESS_CRITERIA.md in operational context
Document gaps between intended mission and actual user experience
Validate system can handle edge cases and degraded conditions
Confirm system supports user workflows end-to-end, not just technical functions

development_stages.name: User Acceptance & Effectiveness Validation
development_stages.description: Conduct user acceptance testing to confirm system effectiveness and suitability for actual use

actions.description: Recruit representative users matching target persona profiles
Execute unguided user acceptance tests using system in intended environment
Measure task completion rates, error rates, and user satisfaction
Identify usability issues and workflow friction points
Validate system improves user outcomes compared to current state
Document user feedback and recommended improvements

exit_criteria: Target users can complete intended tasks

development_stages.name: Release Candidate Certification
development_stages.description: Aggregate quality evidence including operational validation and certify service set for production onboarding

actions.description: Assemble evidence pack: test summaries, security scan results, performance baselines, operational test results
Trace requirements → implementation → tests → operational validation for completeness
Document unresolved technical debt & risk acceptance
Create mission effectiveness report summarizing operational validation
Approve release candidate with sign-off log entry including operational readiness

development_stages.name: Post-Deployment Feedback Loop Initialization
development_stages.description: Establish continuous improvement cycle integrating runtime signals and user feedback back into architecture & code

actions.description: Capture first-week telemetry deltas vs baselines
Feed production incident learnings into architecture change log
Update service_architecture.json or observability.json where model drift detected
Prioritize backlog items from operational insights
Monitor mission effectiveness metrics in production environment
Collect ongoing user feedback and usage patterns
Update SUCCESS_CRITERIA.md based on real-world usage data

blocking_issues: list of issue ids or descriptions
evidence_refs: paths to test reports, scan outputs

change_control.api_changes: Require update to api_contracts.json + contract test adjustments + architecture review entry
change_control.data_model_changes: Require migration plan + data_models.json update + backward compatibility note
change_control.interface_addition: Prohibited without revisiting architecture workflow Steps 2 & 6
change_control.security_policy_changes: Must update compliance.json and run security regression tests

cross_service_impact_protocol.description: When changes to a service affect other services in the ecosystem
triggers: New external interface added to a service
Existing interface contract modified (breaking or non-breaking)
New cross-cutting concerns (auth, approval workflows, etc.)

required_actions.description: Update the modified service's architecture file with new interfaces, dependencies, or capabilities
Service Decomposition and Interface Deduction - to update interface contracts across system
substeps: 2.4: Rebuild system graph to include new interfaces/dependencies
2.6: Update index.json with any new services

required_actions.description: Incremental Validation and Persistence - to ensure consistency
substeps: 6.2: Graph consistency validation (detect circular deps, orphans)

required_actions.description: Register new interfaces in the system-wide interface registry
For each service consuming the modified interface:
tasks: Update their api_contracts.json if they call the modified service
Update their integration_tests.json with new contract tests
Update their service_architecture.json dependencies if needed
Add migration code if breaking changes

required_actions.description: Create/append to architecture change log with:
required_fields: Nature of change (new interface, modification, etc.)

validation_checklist: All modified service_architecture.json files pass template validation
System graph shows no unintended disconnections
All consumer services have updated contracts
Integration tests updated for all affected interfaces
No orphaned interfaces or circular dependencies introduced
Change log entry complete and reviewed

steps: Revert service_architecture.json files to previous versions
Re-run Step 6 validation to ensure consistency

avoid: Skipping contract tests until after implementation
Making cross-service changes without architecture workflow steps 2 & 6
Modifying interfaces without updating all consumers
Skipping mission validation and treating specs as gospel
operational_testing_principles: Development testing verifies 'built correctly' - operational testing validates 'right thing built'
Mission validation with real users in realistic environments
Success criteria based on user outcomes, not technical metrics
Continuous feedback loop from users back to architecture
cross_service_change_triggers: Adding DM approval workflow → affects character_service, campaign_service, user_service
Adding narrative/lore system → affects character_service, content_generation_service
Modifying character data model → affects game_rules_service, session_service
Adding new authentication pattern → affects all services

natural_language_examples: execute this process on system alpha
execute this process on service portfolio located at systems/alpha/portfolio/
run dev workflow for system brain starting at stage D3
continue development workflow for system alpha service metrics

behavior.auto_detect_system: Traverse upward until 'systems' directory encountered to determine system_name
behavior.auto_detect_service: If path includes service_architecture.json parent directory name is service

limitations: Runner does not execute real builds/tests yet—emits planned actions
Quality gates are advisory until integrated with CI
Natural language parsing is heuristic; fall back to explicit flags when ambiguous
